advisory_runtime.meaning: Coarse modeled scheduling estimate from actual whole fixed-fixture suite duration (not a census benchmark). Three F23 oracle variants have48 states; state and squared-length ratios are an explicit conservative-style heuristic, not a guaranteed upper bound.
advisory_runtime.policy_note: AGENTS permits null advisory estimates; unchanged experiment_protocol lint currently rejects null estimated_total_seconds on frozen records. This honest modeled value meets that administrative tooling constraint without changing policy or source.

disk.binary_size_qualification: Unit value is an existing fixture observation, not a bound on the future compiled binary. Native RLIMIT_AS and disk preflight protect the machine; abnormal growth produces partial failure, no missing q.
disk.derivation: States <=512*821638 uncompressed bytes; gzip <=2*that+49*1024=841407488. Seven already-gzip logical outputs retain their exact names. Reserve further bounded preparation/summary/process/source/binary/input metadata plus temporary compiler/checker work and operational headroom; 4GiB is a machine guard, not measured output/compression.
disk.source_capture_formula: Each of 49 child process events embeds before+after full source closure. Each snapshot base64 size <=4*ceil(source_bytes/3) plus names/digests; native events additionally include actual compiled binary bytes/base64. process output includes actual stdin base64 and compiler/version metadata. All exact future binary/file sizes are observed at invocation, never guessed hashes.

memory.qualification: Object model uses ordinary 64-bit CPython list/pointer/int sizes; actual process-lifetime ru_maxrss recorded separately. At most one curve records list is retained; not an RSS guarantee.

retained_reconciliation: Producer census leaves controls.json and regression.json.gz not_run. Existing published fixed controls are pre-admission evidence; independent finalcd89 own disjoint implementation must fully reconcile216setups/345600singles/36864physicaltraces/12288incrementaltraces/73728cells/3068802words and all new scalar/cells before finite-law qualification.
source_capture: Exact full sourcebytes/base64 and hashes immediately before/after every scientific child invocation; binary bytes/hash for every native invocation; compiler executable hash/version/flags, stdin bytes/hash, argv, selected noncredential environment, PID, actual RC/signal, times, preserved original stdout/stderr. On exceptions write partial/source/process artifacts; missing data stays missing. Supervisor outer termination receipt supplies actual driver exit identity.
storage: Science is unauthenticated with CRYPTO_AR_BLOBSTORE and AWS credential variables removed by root. Seven declared gzip logical files stay exact compressed bytes/basenames under native compaction. Later root publishes identity pointers+modern manifest and fullGET verifies same content without rewriting receipt or scientific outputs.

watchdog.reason: Separate finite process guard against hung compiler/pipe/native child or accidental runaway. It is not a budget, measured duration or scientific stopping rule; timeout preserves partial and gives no q for missing coverage.
